scope: Measurement extracts from all 39 replay records (117 solves). This file reproduces the reported summaries and plots, not the original PDE solves. Original record digests identify the retained full records. Nested timer histories, captured arrays and reference arrays are omitted. Sources, deployments, every solve outcome, ranks, residuals, total costs and sampled memory are retained.
